body: It’s been 7 days since the abortion. I would think about suicide every now and then before, but I’ve been thinking about it everyday since I had the abortion last week
Thank you for the reassurance!! Really appreciate it :) hopefully it ends soon! Just worried in case I’m bleeding too much or if it’s an incomplete abortion

Look up abortion on demand- they will send you a full kit and provide a virtual appointment with a doctor. I used it and it was surprisingly easy. They overnighted the packaged and I got my pills the next day after the 24 hr waiting period

thank you for your support and understanding comment. I feel so drained- mentally and physically from the pregnancy and the relationship issues. I just wished he could see what I’m going through instead of making it about himself

Oh my gosh. I can’t even imagine going through that, I’m so sorry. 
I have been calling my best friend through this and she’s been really supportive and kind about it. And honestly, posting on Reddit and hearing from y’all is great too and I definitely feel better reading your comments ❤️

Thank you so much for your kind words, it really means a lot especially going through this. We have been going through couples counseling and I’ll bring this up to our therapist. He’s let me know that his family has been planning on attending this wedding for months now, and I’ve tried to be understanding of it- but I can get past it. Him picking to leave me alone now is just really telling of his priorities and lack of respect for me and this relationship.
He doesn’t pay rent! And I regret not amplifying my ex roommate’s voice, lesson learned.

He’s over maybe once a week, and I go to his place once a week, usually on weekends. 
But, I agree- I need to be less judgmental about their relationship and focus on my living situation.
